data.title: Say what to do, and why
data.subtitle: Two fixes from Anthropic's prompting guide: say it positively, give the reason.

right.label: SAY
items: Write in smoothly flowing prose paragraphs
No ellipses: a text-to-speech engine will read this aloud
Keep it under 100 words: it's read on a phone
Use everyday words: the readers are new to this
Say "I don't know" when you're not sure
